items.text: At the March 14 city council meeting, the council approved the new downtown parking plan in a 5-2 vote. Councilmember Alvarez noted that the plan includes a two-year trial of extended meter hours. The city's budget office will present a cost analysis at the next meeting. Residents can submit comments via the city website until April 1. The meeting minutes will be posted online by Friday.

items.text: The latest newsletter from the Riverside Community Center covers upcoming events and news. This month, we feature the new fitness center opening on May 15, with free classes for the first week. We also highlight the volunteer opportunities at the community garden, where volunteers are needed for spring planting. The newsletter includes a reminder about the center's adjusted summer hours, starting June 1. Our automated phone system will announce these hours when you call. Additionally, we are collecting donations for the local food bank until May 30. Please consider contributing non-perishable items at the front desk. The newsletter concludes with a profile of long-time volunteer Maria Sanchez, who has dedicated over 500 hours to the center. Her story is an inspiration to us all.
